svg.title: OmniRet contrastive and triplet learning architecture
svg.desc: Complete editable reconstruction of the figure: left legend for frozen/trainable icons, central OmniRet query-side network with stacked pooling/LLM/resampler/projector/encoder modules, lower omni-modality query panel with text prompts and media examples, right omni-modality candidate panel with video/audio/image/text examples, embeddings, dashed arrows and loss annotations. Confirmed SAM assets replace only small frozen/trainable icons and waveform crops after visible SVG construction.

g.desc: Legend frame at the left: blue ice cube marks Frozen and flame marks Trainable.
Top embedding labels and loss arrows: the central loss spans query and candidate embeddings with dashed black arrows.

Central OmniRet query-side model. Origin is the outer rounded green frame; contents are stacked vertically with bilateral visual/audio branches below the shared media resampler. Symmetry basis: visual and audio branches are horizontally paired under shared media resampler; upper pooling and LLM bars span the full model width.
Diversity loss bracket at left of the main model: dashed vertical guide with horizontal connector to the model branch, labeled M.

Lower left omni-modality query frame. Origin is the rounded mint frame; prompt text starts at left, dotted colored references conduct rightward to video, image and audio examples. A gray arrow points upward from this query frame to the central model.

Right omni-modality candidate frame. Origin is the OmniRet header; downward content is a pink candidate block with video filmstrip, audio waveform, image and caption. Symmetry basis: labels are left aligned; media examples occupy the right column.
Confirmed SAM replacements: each image preserves the original source_crop coordinates and replaces only the corresponding draft construction. Text, frames and borders are kept.
